cn.description: 磨耳 - 在生活中邂逅英语，用耳朵收录世界 【设计理念】 我们相信，最好的语言学习不发生在枯燥的课堂，而发生在生活的每一个缝隙里。 “磨耳”不是为了让你完成任务，而是帮你把生活中遇到的每一个生词、每一句心动的短语，转化为地道的听觉记忆。不为学习而学习，只为在生活中自然而然地听懂世界。 【核心功能亮点】 生活生词，一键“入耳”： 在路边招牌、电影对白、或随笔笔记中偶遇的生词，随手输入。利用专业级 AI 语音技术，让冰名的文字瞬间变身标准、自然的母语发音。 多变口音，真实语境： 支持随机切换多种地道音色。拒绝单一机械音，让你在碎片时间里适应不同人的发音风格，模拟最真实的语言环境。 碎片时间的听力剧场： 利用通勤、排队、做家务的每一分钟。通过智能循环和播放列表功能，让那些生活中的生词在耳边反复浸润，把无效时间变成语感进化的黄金时刻。 随心掌控，自由跟读： 支持语速精细调节。无论是想要极致慢速的“影子跟读”，还是高频磨耳朵的泛听，都能完美契合你的节奏。 【为什么选择磨耳？】 生活驱动： 听你真正遇到的单词，学你真正用得上的英语。 拒绝枯燥： 随机音色让每一次听力练习都充满新鲜感。 极简主义： 无广告、无干扰，只为打造最纯粹的磨耳朵环境。 隐私政策：https://drill.delibra.top/privacy 服务条款：https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

• Select a backing track to accompany headphone metronome clicks as you record.
• Fixed headphone detection in the Recorder.
• Add a low cut filter to Riffs (a low cut filter reduces muddiness when mixing Riffs, a 30 Hz default will apply to all new recordings).
• Moved gain controls to a new menu with the low cut controls.

cn.description: Record, clip, arrange, and listen, with ease. Capture your instrument or voice as ideas come and explore how they fit together with an efficient tempo first approach to audio clipping, arranging, and low latency mixing. Practice the perfect take with in earbud click and backing track options. Whistle a tune and loop it in any arrangement you want. When you're happy with the sound, export your creations through sharing. This a tool for songwriters, no matter if you play guitar, cello, or just hum. If Voice Memos isn't enough but DAWs are too much work, give Riffer Madness a try. Explore: Library: filter, sort, manage, share, and preview all your creations Recorder: capture audio with optional metronome clicks plus backing track in headphones Editor: make Riffs - assign a BPM, adjust gain and low cut, and clip audio to exact beats Canvas: arrange Riffs and Compositions over beat lines Concepts: Riff: Clipped audio with configurable BPM, gain, and low cut Composition: Musical slots arranged on a 10 minute canvas of beat lines (Compositions can be nested within other Compositions) Slot: either a Riff or a Composition Low Cut: removes low frequency noise that makes mixes muddy Features: Low latency playback - preview anything you create, quickly Duplicate Riffs share a single audio source - make multiple Riffs from a single recording without storage penalties Tools for metadata management - use tags to stay organized Metronome clicks in headphones while recording - get your timing right Backing track in headphones while recording - follow a Composition or practice a song TOOLS Library Eye Button (context sensitive): (No slots selected) Create Empty Compositions Create Riffs Filter Sort (One or more slots selected) Compose: start a new Composition with the selected slot(s) Duplicate Share Tag Delete Recorder: Set BPM Toggle headphones Configure backing track with count-in and loop settings Record from bottom mic with no audio processing Editor: Adjust Clip Boundaries Play Loop (toggle) Metronome (toggle): BPM can be changed in the Book tool Snap to Leading Beat (toggle): leading clip edge snaps to beat lines Snap to Trailing Beat (toggle): trailing clip edge snaps to beat lines Focus: zoom to the region of selected slots Adjust Gain and Low Cut Book: edit metadata: name, start, end, gain, low cut, BPM, color, and tags Canvas: Rectangle Select (long hold on the Canvas will trigger it) Play Loop (toggle) Metronome (toggle): BPM can be changed in the Book tool Snap to Leading Beat (toggle): slots snap their leading edge to the nearest beat when dragged Snap to Trailing Beat (toggle): slots snap their trailing edge to the nearest beat when dragged Slot Tools: Group (toggle): treat selected slots as a single unit Tornado: arrange selected slots end to end Duplicate: copy selected slots and place copies Focus: zoom to the region of selected slots Delete: remove selected slots from the canvas Library: import Riffs and Compositions Book: edit metadata: name, BPM, color, and tags CONTACT Questions or feedback? Please contact us at support@riffermadness.app.

cn.releaseNotes:
NEWS AND DEALS

CardPecker now follows the card world for you and brings back what matters, every morning.

• Deals lead with the terms. Spend thresholds, statement credits, points earned, and whether an offer needs activating — all before you open anything. Filter by issuer to see only the cards you carry.

• Every story says where it came from. Confirmed by the issuer or airline itself, or reported by a named publication, so you can weigh it for yourself and open the original source in a tap.

• Alerts on your terms. Choose whether news, deals, or both are worth interrupting you for, and change your mind whenever you like.

• Read and unread stay apart. What you have already looked at moves out of the way, and anything you dismiss stays dismissed.

• Always current. The feed refreshes when you come back to the app, and stories retire once they are no longer news.

Everything else you rely on is unchanged: your best card for every purchase, benefit and credit tracking, on-device receipt scanning, and iCloud backups.
cn.description: CardPecker — Use Your Best Card Stop guessing which credit card to use. CardPecker instantly shows which card earns the most for dining, hotels, airlines, groceries, travel, and more — and tells you when an offer or a program change is worth knowing about. CHOOSE THE BEST CARD Add your cards and reward multipliers once. Select a spending category to see your cards ranked by their effective return, including the estimated points and cash value you could earn. TODAY'S CARD NEWS Award chart changes, annual fee moves, new routes and program shake-ups, gathered each morning from the publications that cover them. Every story says where it came from — confirmed by the issuer or airline itself, or reported by a named publication — so you can judge it for yourself. CARD-LINKED DEALS Amex Offers, Chase Offers, Citi Offers and merchant promotions, with the terms up front: spend thresholds, statement credits, points earned, and whether the offer has to be activated first. Filter by issuer, and open the original source whenever you want to check the details. NEVER FORGET A BENEFIT Track travel credits, dining credits, lounge access, free nights, checked-bag benefits, and more. Benefits automatically renew according to the schedule you configure, so you can quickly see what remains available. TRACK PURCHASES AND RECEIPTS Record a purchase directly from a card recommendation. CardPecker calculates the points earned and estimated value using the card's reward multiplier. Review receipt history, filter by card, and monitor monthly totals. SCAN RECEIPTS ON-DEVICE Photograph a paper receipt and let CardPecker read the merchant and total. Receipt recognition happens directly on your iPhone, and saving the receipt image is optional. BUILT FOR MULTI-CARD WALLETS Whether you carry two cards or twelve, CardPecker makes reward categories easier to manage. Use subcategories to distinguish airlines, hotels, and other brands when different cards earn different rates. ALERTS ON YOUR TERMS Choose whether news, deals, or both are worth an alert. Turn either off at any time, and CardPecker stops sending it. OPTIONAL ICLOUD BACKUPS Schedule daily, weekly, or monthly backups to iCloud Drive. Restore your cards, benefits, purchase history, and saved receipt images when moving to another iPhone. PRIVATE BY DESIGN No account is required. Your cards, benefits, and receipt history are stored locally on your device, and receipt scanning uses on-device text recognition. News and deals are fetched from CardPecker's own service, and nothing about your cards or your spending is sent with the request. CardPecker does not ask for your location.

cn.description: Welcome To OutRace OutRace is a pseudo 3D racing video game in which the player controls a racing car a third-person rear perspective. The camera is placed near the ground, the road curves, crests, and dips, which increases the challenge by obscuring upcoming obstacles such as traffic that the player must avoid. The game world is divided into multiple stages that each end in a checkpoint, and reaching the end of a stage provides more time. Fog stage, snowy stage, night stage, sand storm stage... This game is a speed runner endless game. Controls (Remote Control) Left and right to drive car. Tap and hold select button to brake. Tap and hold play/pause to accelerate. Enjoy!

cn.description: Your Feelings Deserve More Than a Color on a Chart. Emotica is the journal you can actually talk to. Speak a thought out loud and it becomes a reflection, no typing required. Track how you feel, discover why, and grow, one check-in at a time. Unlike simple mood trackers, Emotica remembers your journey. It learns your patterns, connects your experiences, and helps you see the story behind your emotions. TALK, DON'T TYPE Voice journaling turns a spoken thought into a written entry in seconds. Transcription happens on your iPhone, so your audio never leaves the device. Perfect for the moments when writing feels like too much. LIVE VOICE COACH Have a real conversation out loud. Speak naturally and your coach responds in the moment, in your language, with a voice you choose. It can log how you're feeling, start an exercise, or set a reminder while you talk. MENTAL CLOUDS: YOUR PERSONAL EMOTIONAL SKY Express your emotions as floating clouds in a living sky. Watch feelings drift, blend, and fade as your day unfolds. Add thoughts, notes, and reflections to each cloud. Journaling made visual, intuitive, and beautiful. AI COACH THAT ACTUALLY KNOWS YOU Talk to a coach that remembers your past reflections, understands your goals, and offers guidance shaped by your history, not generic advice. It can set reminders, schedule check-ins, and suggest exercises based on how you're feeling right now. GUIDED MEDITATION, AFFIRMATIONS & SLEEP A full library of exercises with soothing guided audio in both women's and men's voices. Meditations to calm your mind, affirmations to build confidence, and sleep sessions to help you drift off. Your coach recommends the right one at the right moment. SHARE PRIVATELY WITH FAMILY Choose a single entry and share it with someone you trust. Every share is end to end encrypted, so only they can read it. You appear under an anonymous handle, and connecting never shares anything on its own. Nothing leaves your device unless you pick it. MILESTONES Join gentle multi-day milestones that turn reflection into a habit and watch your progress build. DEEP INSIGHT ENGINE Go beyond bar charts. Emotica analyses your emotions, triggers, and notes to surface patterns you would never spot alone, like how certain routines lift your mood or how your resilience builds over time. Visualise your journey through beautiful graphs and calendars. RICH, EFFORTLESS CHECK-INS Log up to three emotions at once from 35 emotions across 8 categories. Add triggers, intensity, photos, sketches, voice notes, and location. Build a multi-dimensional timeline of your inner life in seconds. SMART PROMPTS & REMINDERS Emotica learns from your day: workouts, travel, photo moments, sleep patterns. It gently prompts you to reflect when it matters most. Set custom reminders so journaling becomes a daily habit. PRIVACY FIRST Passcode and Face ID protection. On-device AI processing. Your reflections stay yours, always. ALSO INCLUDES Apple Watch check-in using the Digital Crown Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, plus Siri shortcuts Apple Health integration for heart rate, sleep, and mindful minutes Journal streaks and streak calendar Favourites to bookmark meaningful entries Full data export and encrypted backup Available in English, Spanish, German, Russian, Hindi, Arabic, and Chinese Beautiful cosmic design with light and dark themes Full iPad and Mac support with spacious layouts Whether you're managing stress, building gratitude, or simply curious about your emotional patterns, Emotica gives you the clarity to understand yourself better. Start reflecting. Start understanding. Start growing. Prices are shown in the app before you buy.

cn.releaseNotes:
Adaptive Hiking 在 2.1 版本中走向全球。

• 新增来自世界各地的 50 条适合残障人士的路线
• 新增美国、德国、中国、中国香港、中国台湾、日本、韩国、英国和澳大利亚的路线
• 扩展无障碍信息，包括轮椅适合度、路面、坡度、无障碍厕所、停车和行动辅助设施
• 通过官方来源验证路线，并更清晰地说明无障碍信息的可信度
• 新增国家和已验证路线筛选器
• 改进路线详情，提供更丰富的无障碍备注、亮点和警告
• 支持德语、简体中文、繁体中文、日语和韩语
• 全面改进无障碍术语
• 更好地处理缺失的路线数据，清楚显示未知信息，而不是自行推断
• 提升整体可靠性、本地化和界面体验

我们的目标始终很简单：帮助更多人找到可以放心探索的户外路线。
cn.description: AdaptiveHiking 可帮助您检查路线、找到步行路线，并以更平静、无障碍优先的计划开始步行。 仅在需要时建立快速个人资料，选择步行模式，例如“日常”、“温和日间”、“无台阶”、“家庭/婴儿车”、“建立信心”、“长途”或“自定义”，然后将路线与简单语言的 Route Fit 进行比较。您会看到强拟合、中等拟合、弱拟合或无法确认，以及单独的数据置信度和明确的原因。 2.0版本包括： 重新设计的“今日”屏幕围绕“检查路线”、“查找步行路线”和“开始步行” 路线适合摘要，包括个性化的持续时间范围、预期休息、上升和下降、困难路段、设施、日光结果、已知出口和缺失信息 GPX、KML、GeoJSON 和 CSV 的私有路线导入，包括轨迹、路线、多路段、海拔、时间戳和名称 针对表面、台阶、大门、阶梯、封闭物、植被、厕所、水、长凳、桥梁、牲畜、改道、危险、休息点和已知出口的结构化私人路线编辑 实时行走，显示核心位置进度、配速、已用时间、GPS 置信度、预计完成时间和中断恢复 私人步行历史记录、可选的设备上学习以及计划外的步速检查步行 免费保存的路线以及结构化离线包，其中包含路线几何形状、注释、设施、出口、紧急情况详细信息、预测摘要和路线适合度 结构化社区访问报告，包含确认、解决和到期流程 AdaptiveHiking保持平静、实用的向导声音，并支持本地化距离、海拔、天气、安全、权限和路线引导。路线信息可能仍然不完整，因此请在出行前查看当地官方信息来源和当前状况。 AdaptiveHiking 支持计划和信心；它不提供医疗或紧急建议。

cn.description: Squishy is an oddly satisfying fruit ASMR toy for your iPhone. Tap, hold, drag, pop, press, and burst your way through a shelf of juicy fruit. Each fruit has its own sound, visual style, and haptic feel, turning your iPhone into a tiny tactile squish machine. Start with simple fruit, earn Squish Points, unlock new favourites, and discover premium fruit with richer feedback. Hold to build pressure, release in the Perfect Zone, or push it too far and feel the messy over-pressure burst. Squishy is simple on purpose: open the app, tap the fruit, feel the squish. Features include: Tap, hold, and drag fruit iPhone haptics for tactile feedback Unique haptic feel for each fruit Pressure-building squish interactions Perfect Zone feedback Juicy particle effects ASMR-style squish, pop, crunch, and burst sounds Unlockable fruit shelf Squish Points Daily fruit challenge Vibration and Vibration Intensity controls Record Mode for cleaner screen recording Optional one-time premium fruit unlocks No account required Launch fruit includes banana, strawberry, orange, apple, peach, kiwi, pineapple, watermelon, mango, and coconut. Squishy does not require a camera, microphone, contacts, location, or account. It is just fruit, sound, haptics, and deeply unnecessary satisfaction. Tap the fruit. Hold for pressure. Release for the squish.

cn.description: The last thing a distracted mind needs is a distracting timer. Countdown clocks make you watch the clock. Pomodoro systems give you another system to manage. Most focus tools pull your attention away from the work you're trying to do. Current turns time into something you feel rather than watch. Pick 5, 15, 30 minutes, or set your own. The screen shifts slowly from green to red — color, motion, and haptics telling you where you are without pulling your attention from what you're doing. No countdown clock. No system to follow. No dashboard to optimize. Built for distractible minds, and anyone who doesn't want the tool to get in the way of the work. One-time purchase. No subscription.

cn.releaseNotes: تعديلات عامه
cn.description: المكتبة الإسلامية الشاملة: كنوز المعرفة الإسلامية بين يديك اكتشف عالمًا واسعًا من المعرفة الإسلامية مع المكتبة الإسلامية الشاملة، تطبيقك الشامل الذي يضم مجموعة ضخمة من الكتب الإسلامية القيمة. استمتع بالوصول إلى مجموعة هائلة من الكتب التي تغطي جميع جوانب الإسلام والمسلمين، بما في ذلك العقيدة والتاريخ والفقه والأخلاق والعلوم. استكشف مجموعة متنوعة من المواضيع، بما في ذلك: كتب التفسير والحديث كتب السيرة النبوية كتب الفقه وأصوله كتب العقيدة والتوحيد كتب التاريخ الإسلامي كتب الأدب العربي والإسلامي كتب الأقوال والأفعال والأخلاق كتب الذكر والدعاء كتب الدعوة وطلب العلم كتب الكبائر والمحرمات كتب باللغات الأخرى كتب متنوعه تتجاوز المكتبة الإسلامية الشاملة مجرد كونها مجموعة كتب. إنها بوابة إلى عالم من المعرفة والتنوير، مما يسمح لك بتعميق فهمك للإسلام وتوسيع آفاقك الفكرية. مميزات التطبيق: واجهة سهلة الاستخدام للتنقل السريع والبحث القدرة على حفظ الكتب المفضلة لديك للرجوع إليها لاحقًا القدرة على تنزيل الكتب نصوص عالية الجودة وواضحة للقراءة السهلة تحديثات منتظمة بإضافة كتب جديدة باستمرار قم بتنزيل المكتبة الإسلامية الشاملة اليوم وانطلق في رحلة معرفية لا تُنسى. اكتشف كنوز المعرفة الإسلامية واستكشف عالمًا من الإيمان والتنوير.

cn.description: Meshman 3D Viewer is a great app to view and convert 3D model files: STL, OBJ, DXF, 3MF, USD, DAE, 3DS, DWG, FBX, PLY, OFF. Features: Open & Export files from formats: STL (Stereolithography, supports ASCII & Binary) OBJ (Wavefront format) DXF (AutoCAD format, supports ASCII & Binary) 3MF (3D Manufacturing format) USD (Universal Scene Description) DAE (COLLADA file format) 3DS (3D Studio format) PLY (Polygon file format, supports ASCII & Binary) OFF (Object file format) Open (only) files from: DWG (AutoCAD format) FBX (Autodesk Filmbox format) Load from a ZIP or RAR file one of the files the app can open. Measure distance between points within your model. Graphic operations for Rotating, panning, zooming. View your model in Orthogonal or Perspective mode. cn.description: Picolla会把大家的照片变成艺术作品。在大家的照片上添加各种花贴纸和图形，做出波希米亚风格的拼贴画吧。 提供20个以上的拼贴画模板 从事先设计的模板中选择一个，把样品照片换成自己的照片就可以简单地完成艺术作品！也可以按照自己的要求自由编辑。 照片切片功能 使用自动切片工具，可像魔法一样从照片中删除背景或物体，也可看放大的照片进行删除，还可以细致地补充要留下的领域。 多种贴纸和图形 包含300个以上花贴纸和多种图形、背景图片，并会持续更新。 提升的图层基础编辑功能 为了防止不小心选择或删除其他编辑的目标而非自己想要编辑的目标则可以将图层锁定或设置为不显示。 无限图层与简单的操作 添加图层无限制，可生成符合自己需求的图层，只需要将图层缩图上下拖拉即可改变顺序。 时尚的字体 严选30个英文字体。在大家的拼贴画中添加一些感性的字体排印。 具有艺术感的滤镜 严选了20个必备照片滤镜。轻松地将大家的照片塑造成具有魅力的照片吧。 支持透明PNG 可使用或储存透明PNG。设置为透明背景后，剪出照片上喜欢的部分来制作出属于自己的贴纸吧。 Picolla总会倾听大家的意见。有任何咨询事项或意见都随时欢迎。 电子邮件 : picolla@mocadeco.com

cn.description: 新木鱼是一款帮助人们达到内心平静和智慧的应用程序。与传统的佛教寺庙中使用的木鱼不同，它是一个数字化的版本，可以在手机或平板电脑上使用。 这个应用程序的核心功能是敲击木鱼，每次敲击后，您可以看到“功德+1”的显示。同时，您也可以根据自己的需要自定义显示的文字，让修行体验更加个性化。此外，我们还提供了两种漂浮文字轨迹供您选择，让您的修行过程更加绚丽多彩。 为了满足用户的个性化需求，我们提供了多种木鱼皮肤。您可以根据自己的喜好随意更换木鱼的外观，让修行过程更加有趣。无论是简约风格还是复古风格，都能让您找到最适合自己的木鱼皮肤。 通过这个应用程序，您可以累积功德，提升福慧，并在紧张的生活中找到内心的平静与智慧。您可以随时随地打开应用程序，进行修行和冥想，让自己的心灵得到宁静与安详。 手机木鱼是一种数字乐器，可以通过智能手机应用程序进行演奏。它模拟了传统木鱼的声音，但具有更多样化和自由度，同时也非常便携。 手机木鱼通常包含多个不同类型的木鱼音色。例如，有些可能模拟传统的铜制或木制木鱼的声音，而另一些则可能具有现代化的电子音色。这使得演奏者可以在不同的演出和场合中选择最适合的音色。 新木鱼不仅提供了传统的木鱼声音，还包括其他许多种类的佛教音乐，例如佛号声、经文朗诵、禅诵等。这些音乐具有放松和净化身心的作用，帮助用户更好地进行禅修和冥想活动，达到内心平静的状态。 此外，新木鱼提供了许多方便的功能，例如自定义音调和节奏、循环播放、定时关闭等。用户可以根据自己的需要来设置这些功能，以获得最佳的音乐效果。 总之，新木鱼是一款非常实用和有用的应用程序，可以帮助人们放松自己的心灵，找到内心平静与智慧。如果您正在寻找一款有效的冥想工具，那么新木鱼一定会成为您的不二选择。

cn.description: 二维码扫不出来,或者担心里面的链接是否安全——QR Code Pro 正是为此而生。用摄像头对准任意二维码、条形码或 NFC 标签,即可快速精准识别,创建和自定义专属码同样迅捷。一次购买,解锁全部功能,永久无广告。 即时扫描 让 iPhone 秒变高精度扫描仪。打开摄像头或导入照片,QR Code Pro 可在几秒内识别 13 种格式: QR、Aztec、Data Matrix、Code 128、Code 39、Code 39 Mod 43、Code 93、EAN-13、EAN-8、Interleaved 2 of 5、ITF-14、PDF417、UPC-E 支持超广角摄像头,轻松扫描大尺寸或难以靠近的码;批量扫描可一次性连续采集多个码,无需逐个停顿。 安全链接检测 打开扫描到的链接前,QR Code Pro 会自动检测伪装域名、短链接、未加密的 HTTP 连接,以及异常冗长或可疑的网址,帮你放心判断是否点击。 NFC 扫描 读取 iPhone 支持的 NFC 标签,包括包含多条记录的标签——每条记录都能完整、准确地读取和显示。 创建与自定义二维码 只需几步,即可为网址、Wi-Fi 网络、联系人、电话号码、邮箱、短信、文本、位置或日历事件生成二维码。自定义颜色、定位角样式、中心图案样式,还能加入专属 Logo——非常适合名片、菜单、课堂或活动使用。 打印与分享 直接在 iPhone 上打印二维码,支持调整版式;也可将码分享出去,用于包装、传单、海报和产品标签。 井然有序 无限扫描记录让每一次扫描都有迹可循,收藏夹让常用的码触手可及。iCloud 同步可在你的 Apple 设备间共享扫描记录和已创建的码,还能自由设置启动时默认打开扫描、创建或历史标签页。 一次购买,全部功能 QR Code Pro 为一次性购买,无订阅、无内购、永久无广告。安装即可解锁以上全部功能: 支持 QR、Data Matrix 及 13 种条形码格式扫描 支持超广角摄像头,轻松扫描更大或更远的码 批量扫描,一次连续识别多个码 打开链接前进行安全链接检测 支持 NFC 标签读取,包括多记录标签 创建与自定义二维码,可加入专属 Logo 直接打印,支持调整版式 无限扫描记录与收藏夹 跨 Apple 设备 iCloud 同步 可自选启动默认标签页 无订阅、无内购、无广告 无论是查看餐厅菜单、核对快递取件码,还是为 Wi-Fi 密码或名片生成二维码,又或只是想在点击前确认链接是否安全,都可以用它轻松搞定。 使用条款:https://t4fapps.com/tos-chatlink.html 隐私政策:https://t4fapps.com/privacy-policy-paid.html 感谢您的支持!

cn.description: Duplicate Manager Pro检测并删除重复项： 照片，视频，音轨，文档，其他文​​件。 易于使用，操作速度快，智能自动选择 - 这些是应用程序概念的基本原则，可快速删除重复项。 ◉为什么选择Duplicate Manager Pro 该应用程序的主要优势是一个独特的算法自动选择重复！ 自动选择您想要删除的重复项。 能够排除自动选择的文件夹（包括子文件夹和文件），文件和文件类型。 能够设置文件夹的优先级并定义哪个文件夹将保留原文件。 为所有扫描文件夹保留一个原稿。 在每个扫描文件夹中保留一个原稿。 高速自动选择。 自动选择的多方差。 能够扫描多个文件夹和存储设备中的重复项。 在Photos库，iTunes资料库中查找重复内容。 查找相同或相似的文件（7种文件比较模式）。 删除Google Drive和Dropbox等云存储中的外部驱动器，网络文件夹中的重复项。 使用管理员权限删除重复的文件。 该应用程序可以保存扫描结果。您可以退出应用程序并继续在任何方便的时间为您工作。 应用程序保存所有扫描作业设置。不要花时间每次更改每个扫描作业的设置。将所有扫描作业设置一次！ 预安装的扫描作业。 按计划自动扫描任意数量的扫描作业。当您不使用Mac时，应用程序会扫描文件夹。不要把时间花在扫描过程上。在任何方便的时间为您处理扫描结果！ 购买专业版之前先试用免费版。我们不会隐藏独特的自动选择重复，质量和应用程序的速度。 你的时间是你最珍贵的！我们关心你的时间。 ◉适合初学者 选择预安装的扫描作业（照片，电影，文档...或硬盘驱动器）。 点击“扫描”按钮。 所有扫描设置都为每项作业进行了最佳配置。 ◉对于最严格的专业人员 2种查找文件的方式： 找到重复的文件 找到大文件 7种文件比较模式： 内容（校验和 - SHA1） 内容和名称 名称，日期和大小 姓名和日期 名称 大文件 按名称分组的大文件 优化以处理大量文件。最小的内存使用量。 每天，每周或在预定时间进行一次自动计划扫描。 高级搜索所选组的重复组和项目（名称包含，名称开头，路径包含，路径和名称包含，...）。 对所选组的重复组和项目进行排序。 每个扫描作业的设置： 将复制品移至垃圾箱或永久删除垃圾箱。 能够在删除重复的地方创建别名。 排除扫描列表。您可以排除文件，文件夹，文件类型（包括隐藏文件夹，文件和文件别名）。 排除自动选择列表。您可以排除文件，文件夹和文件类型。 扫描的最小文件大小。 能够将软件包类型设置为以文件形式扫描（其他软件包将作为文件夹扫描）。 能够将应用程序窗口转换为扫描过程的紧凑指示器。 您可以使用内置或外部"QuickLook"预览文件。能够显示多个文件（当您按名称使用比较模式时很有用）。 复制，添加，删除，移动任何扫描作业。 支持"Drag & Drop"模式。 能够快速跳转到文件路径中的任何文件或文件夹。

cn.description: Turn your phone into an off-road cockpit. Whether you're climbing rocky trails or exploring scenic routes, 4x4 Cockpit gives you real-time insight into your vehicle, terrain, and route — on your phone and on your car's CarPlay screen. Core Features: Tilt Visualization — Track roll and pitch with large animated indicators, oversized percentage numbers, and risk-based colors that shift from safe to caution to danger Adjustable Risk Limits — Set your own thresholds for when tilt gauges turn yellow and red, tuned to your vehicle and terrain Speed, Altitude & Compass — View live driving data at a glance, with GPS-assisted heading for reliable direction while moving Acceleration Bar — Monitor acceleration and braking with dynamic feedback Slope Units Your Way — Show steepness in degrees (°), percent (%), per mille (‰) or vertical-to-horizontal ratio (1:n) CarPlay Integration — Choose between Visual, Classic, and Extended display modes, with large sunlight-readable numbers; drag the readings into the order you want — the same order applies to your phone screen Landscape & Portrait — Full support for horizontal and vertical orientation on Phone, including Reset Position when the device is mounted sideways Metric or Imperial — Switch between km/h, m and mph, ft from the Settings screen (auto-detected on first launch); applies to the live cockpit, ride recordings and exported maps 18 Interface Languages — English (UK), English (US), 中文, हिन्दी, Español, العربية, Français, বাংলা, Português, Bahasa Indonesia, اردو, Deutsch, 日本語, Naijá, Tiếng Việt, Türkçe, Polski and Русский — pick yours from a flag list; the on-screen instruction adapts too Ride Recording — Record your route and export it as a map image with localized details Offline Maps — Save maps for later use and export them with overlays and details Smart Calibration — Reset Position to set your own level reference; recalibration prompts are skipped when a recent reading is already reliable Optional Intro Screen — Instructions show on first launch and can be toggled off from Settings once you know the app Live Sensor Dashboard — Motion, heading, gravity, GPS, and more in real time Built for off-road drivers, overlanders, explorers, and adventure travel. For informational use only. Always drive responsibly and mount your device securely.

cn.releaseNotes:
Completely New Kinship Navigation List
- Displays all relatives of a designated start person, grouped by degree of kinship
- Makes it significantly easier to navigate within immediate and extended families
- Available throughout the app in the Edit, Charts, and Reports sections
- Choose whether selection or remains fixed to a person selected in advance
- Fine-grained settings let you specify exactly which degrees of kinship should appear in the list
- Works in conjunction with Smart Filters and can also be searched

Improvements to the Kinship System
- The Edit section can optionally display each person’s relationship to the start person below their name
- Supports significantly more degrees of kinship, as many relationships are now calculated algorithmically
- Kinship terms are now calculated specifically for each language, allowing linguistic differences to be represented more accurately
- In languages where kinship terms depend on the exact relationship path, more specific terms are now used—for example, with the compound naming system used in Swedish
- Significantly faster than before
- Partnerships without a recorded marriage can now optionally be included in the analysis

Significantly Improved Mini Timeline
- New, clearer design
- Choose which person and family events are displayed
- Choose whether events involving parents, children, partners, or siblings are also included
- Available from the Interactive Tree and when editing persons and families
- Can now optionally display the place and event description for each event
- Significantly improved layout when displaying a large number of events
- Events can now be sorted
- Date ranges, such as “from 2002 to 2005,” are now correctly marked on the timeline
- A person’s age is now displayed in the same “years, months, days” format used in the Edit section

New Label Report
- Displays all records in your family tree associated with one or more selected labels
- Choose which record types should be displayed, including persons, families, events, and more

Further Improvements
- Improved website export: A person’s age is now displayed for events, and all name components are searchable
- The Charts and Reports menu in the Edit section has been significantly expanded, providing direct access to all relevant charts and reports
- MobileFamilyTree now features significantly improved menus and popovers adapted to Liquid Glass
- Reworked and clearer menus in the Interactive Tree

cn.description: 手工皂计算（Soap Calculator）是一款专为手工皂爱好者与制皂师打造的专业配方计算工具。 从油脂配比、皂化值计算，到 INS 评分、配方评估、成本核算与经典配方管理，帮助您更快速地设计、调整和记录每一款手工皂。 支持固体皂（NaOH）与液体皂（KOH），内置 170+ 常见与进阶油脂数据。所有数据均可在本地使用，无需联网。 核心优势：专业、精准、灵活 动态调参实时评估：在计算结果页直接调整油脂与添加物比例，各项特性指标与成本实时更新，让配方优化更加直观高效。 智能配方评分：计算皂化值（SAP）与 INS 值，并根据 INS 区间提供配方特性参考。多维度雷达图直观展示硬度、清洁力、保湿度、起泡度与细腻度。 固体与液体皂：支持固体皂（NaOH）与液体皂（KOH）计算，并可自定义碱液纯度，满足不同制皂需求。 成本核算：录入原料价格后，可自动计算配方总成本与单块成本。支持 mL、fl oz 等油脂体积单位，并按通用密度换算为重量，适合个人制皂与工作室使用。 170+ 油脂数据：内置丰富的常见与进阶油脂数据，包含皂化值与脂肪酸信息，减少查阅资料的时间。 隐私优先，离线可用：数据本地存储，无需联网即可使用，适合在厨房、工作室等环境中随时设计和查看配方。 功能一览：便捷与高效 灵活输入与单位：支持百分比与重量两种输入模式。重量单位支持克、千克、盎司、磅等，可自由切换。 经典配方与自定义模板：内置经典纯榄皂、阿勒颇古皂等入门配方。支持保存、分类和收藏自定义配方。 极简制作指导：提供手工皂制作中的关键步骤提示，包括安全防护、温度控制与脱模时间等。 iPhone 与 iPad：支持 iPhone 与 iPad 横屏适配，iPad 提供大屏分栏布局，方便配方核对与操作。 配方记录与分享：支持生成配方图片或文字报告，并可通过日历记录制作与脱模日期。 基础配方计算永久免费使用。Pro 一次购买即可解锁完整高级功能，无需订阅，无广告。 无论您制作的是洗面皂、沐浴皂、家事皂还是液体皂，手工皂计算都希望为您提供清晰、可靠的数据支持，成为您日常制皂的得力助手。

cn.description: Every viral meme sound, one tap away. Meme Soundboard puts the internet's biggest sound effects — reactions, drops, brainrot, movie and game clips — right in your pocket, instantly playable with zero lag. HUGE SOUND LIBRARY Every viral meme sound in one place, organized into categories — Gaming, Movies, Brainrot, and more. New sounds are added constantly, so there's always something fresh to play. TRENDING See what everyone's playing right now. If a sound is blowing up, it's right at the top. SEARCH Know the sound you want? Find it in seconds — no endless scrolling through categories. FAVORITES Save your go-to sounds with one tap and build a personal collection you can always get back to. INSTANT PLAY Tap a sound, hear it immediately. No buffering, no waiting. FREE TO USE Play sounds, browse every category, and use search and favorites free, every day. MEME SOUNDBOARD PRO Every sound unlocked — the full library, every pack, every category, no daily limits New sounds first — fresh viral drops land in Pro before anyone else hears them Unlimited favorites — save every go-to sound, no cap on your collection No ads, ever — everything unlocks instantly SUBSCRIPTIONS Meme Soundboard Pro offers flexible plans to unlock premium features: Weekly · Monthly · Yearly · Lifetime (one-time) Prices vary by region and are shown in the app before purchase. Terms of Service: https://redizeuz.com/terms Privacy & Security The app is designed with user privacy in mind and does not share personal data unnecessarily. Privacy Policy: https://redizeuz.com/privacy Disclaimer This app is for entertainment purposes only. Sound effects are provided for personal, non-commercial use.

cn.description: 这是一款通过USB来控制相机的App。 连接相机后， 可以监看相机实时画面，可以控制相机的：曝光、文件格式、白平衡、拍摄模式、比例等等。 也支持把相机上拍的照片传输到手机内，实现相机未插入内存卡也能拍摄，拍摄后照片都会保存到手机端。 这是App的第一个版本，目前仅支持Sony相机，佳能、尼康后续也会支持，敬请期待！

cn.description: 租约档案是一款默认本地保存的租房记录工具，同时适合租客和房东使用。 你可以用它快速记录入住、退租、交房、收房、退房检查、清洁和维修等场景，而不用把流程变成复杂的房产管理系统。 在 2.0 版本中，你可以： 快速创建带照片、备注和检查项的房屋报告 为同一套房屋建立长期保存的租约档案 记录租客身份证明、房东身份证明、合同图片和其他资料 保存入住/交房与退租/收房时的房屋情况留档 核验水、电、燃气等交接读数 记录家具家电清单、状态备注和照片 导出清晰的 PDF 报告，便于留证和分享 在设备内设置本地租金提醒 为什么适合这类用户： 租客可以把入住和退租证据整理在一起 房东可以集中管理交房、收房、水电燃气和资料记录 同一个人既能当租客使用，也能当房东使用 所有数据默认保存在本机 租约档案的目标是轻量、实用、清晰。它不是云协作平台，不提供在线收租，也不是财务记账工具。 欢迎提交功能建议或改进想法： 邮箱：842797413@qq.com 或在 App Store 评价中留下你的想法

cn.releaseNotes:
What's New in Version 2.0
We've completely reimagined the sound production experience in Urban Studio v2.0.
19 New Sound Presets — Beyond LEAD, PAD, and STRINGS, discover RHD, WRL, Organ, Bell, Choir, Warm, Glass, Tape, Jazz Guitar, Pluck, Vocoder, and more. Each built from scratch with its own dedicated sound engine.
Write Mode — Record, arrange, and loop your chord progressions. Assign individual beat durations to each chord and compose your own progressions with up to 16 slots.
Enhanced Audio Engine — A fully rewritten audio engine delivers a cleaner, faster, and lag-free experience. Tempo stability is now maintained even during extended sessions.
cn.description: Break writer's block instantly with Urban Chord Studio. Urban Chord Studio is the ultimate songwriting companion for producers, musicians, and beatmakers. Whether you are looking for a soulful R&B vibe, a dark Trap mood, or a complex Jazz progression, Urban Chord Studio generates professional harmonies in seconds, no music theory required. WHY URBAN CHORD STUDIO? Stop staring at a blank project. Select a genre, explore variations, and find the perfect emotional landscape for your next song. Focus purely on harmony and mood without the distraction of complex drum patterns. KEY FEATURES: 20+ Music Genres: Explore curated progressions for Lo-Fi, Neo-Soul, Trap, Jazz, Cinematic, Pop, Rock, and many more. Advanced Chord Voicings: Instantly access complex chords (7ths, 9ths, 13ths) that sound professional and rich. Atmospheric Sound Engine: Play your chords with high-quality internal synth tones, including lush Pads, Strings, Bass, and Leads. Performance Modes: Switch between Block chords, Arpeggiators, and Strumming modes to hear how the progression flows. Customizable Ambience: Control the Reverb (Space) and BPM to set the perfect atmosphere for your session. Intuitive Interface: A retro-futuristic VFD style design that puts creativity first. PERFECT FOR: Finding inspiration for melodies. Creating backing tracks for improvisation. Learning how different genres use harmony. Sketching song ideas on the go. Unlock your creativity. Download Urban Chord Studio and start writing your next hit today.

cn.releaseNotes:
Countdown Reminder 2.0 — completely redesigned for 2026.

  • Stunning visual redesign with gradient cards, colored shadows, and animated entrance effects
  • Animated flip-clock countdown digits on the detail screen
  • Featured hero card for your nearest upcoming event
  • 10 color themes: Indigo, Ocean, Emerald, Sunset, Rose, Violet, Amber, Teal, Slate, Crimson
  • Light and dark mode with system auto-detection
  • Categories to organize your countdowns
  • Event templates for quick creation
  • Search across all events
  • Grid and list view toggle
  • Milestone checklists per event
  • Cloud sync via Supabase
  • Shareable live countdown links
  • JSON data export and import
  • Confetti celebration on event creation
  • Working days display
  • Long-press quick actions
  • Haptic feedback on all interactions
  • 3-page onboarding experience
cn.description: Never lose track of what matters. Countdown Reminder helps you count down to birthdays, anniversaries, vacations, deadlines, weddings, graduations — anything worth the wait. BEAUTIFUL COUNTDOWNS Create stunning, color-coded countdowns with custom emojis, photos, and 10 handcrafted themes. Watch animated flip-clock digits tick down in real time. Switch between list and grid views. Your nearest event gets a featured hero card front and center. SMART REMINDERS Set preset reminders (1 week, 1 day, 1 hour) or create custom ones down to the minute. Every countdown automatically notifies you when it reaches zero. Never miss a moment again. ORGANIZE YOUR WAY Group events into categories, search across all your countdowns, or start from templates — Birthday, Trip, Wedding, Deadline, and more — that auto-fill emoji, color, and reminders for you. MILESTONES & NOTES Add a preparation checklist to any countdown. Track sub-tasks like "Buy gift", "Book venue", or "Send invitations" with a progress bar showing how ready you are. CLOUD SYNC Sign in once and your countdowns sync across all your devices. Create an event on your phone, see it on your tablet. Powered by Supabase with end-to-end encryption. SHARE LIVE COUNTDOWNS Generate a share code for any countdown and send it to friends or family. They can watch the same countdown tick down in real time — no account needed. EXPORT & BACKUP Export all your data as JSON. Import it on a new device. You're always in control of your data. PRIVACY FIRST No ads. No tracking. No subscriptions. All data stored locally on your device unless you choose to enable cloud sync. Your countdowns are yours. FEATURES AT A GLANCE Unlimited countdowns with custom colors, emojis, and photos 10 color themes with light and dark mode Animated flip-clock countdown display Smart reminders with custom scheduling Categories for organization Event templates for quick creation Milestone checklists per event Cloud sync across devices Shareable live countdown links Working days calculator Calendar export (Google Calendar) Home screen widget JSON data export and import Contact attachment with call, SMS, and WhatsApp Recurring events (daily, weekly, monthly, yearly) 3-page onboarding for new users Haptic feedback throughout Supports English and Spanish

cn.description: KingB is designed to capture the unique tones of the B and C series tonewheel organs. It uses a fresh modeling approach to generate tonewheel signals in real time, as well as to replicate the complex interplay of components that make the organ “sing”. Absolutely no samples are used. The interplay within the intricate network of tonewheels, components, wiring harnesses, and motor elements is synthesized to a convenient set of parameters. By using them, you are able to change the quirks of the underlying organ model. This helps parallel the variances heard among individual examples of the physical instrument, and even allows replicating the effects of aging or out-of-spec electronics. The new rotary speaker emulations are a deep dive into the 3D aural candy that makes tonewheel organs truly shine. Six unique cabinet models are complemented by four amps that provide extra warmth via our “Virtual Tube” technology. An additional guitar amp bus (with three models to choose from) runs parallel to the rotary for even more sound options. A set of carefully selected pre- and post-amplification effects are integrated for good measure (and may all the measures you play be good!) Three manuals, each with its own drawbar set, as well as over 130 organ and FX parameters are MIDI controllable. You can save and share MIDI maps, sound presets, and in-app audio recordings. Factory presets include over 110 sounds varying from laid back Jazz ditties to gnarly, Purple-colored distortion extravaganzas. KingB is ready to join your workflow as an AUv3. Both the app and the plugin are universal, and also support Apple Silicon Chip computers. :: Organ :: 91/96 Virtual Tonewheels, including 12 complex wheels 3 manuals with own drawbar sets Scanner chorus/vibrato Carefully recreated “Swell” (or “Expression”) pedal Percussion with additional user-defined parameters Variable modeling characteristics, including tonewheel interplay, component state and more. 12 silent-switching drawbar presets on Swell and Great manuals, MIDI controllable Optional lower foldback Optional keyclick with adjustable parameters Options to emulate M and T series organs as well as B and C ones. :: Rotary & Amps :: Six rotary cabinets with different tonal and modulation characteristics Adjustable fast and slow speeds for both horn & drum Adjustable acceleration and deceleration Adjustable mic angle, distance, and balance Adjustable stereo panning parameters for both horn & drum Four rotary amp types, as well as bypass DI with panning Parallel guitar amp with three models to choose from :: FX :: Pre-Amp FX include, — Distortion/Overdrive with EQ & Mid Boost — 10-band graphic EQ — Wah with optional auto — Chorus/flanger with variable rate & depth — Tape delay emulation with self-oscillating feedback — Spring reverb Post-Amp FX include, — Compressor with threshold, ratio, attack, and decay. — 15-band graphic EQ — Parametric reverb with 7 room types, pre, decay, and tone. :: Admin Stuff :: Also runs as AUv3 DAW-friendly fluid layout Fully configurable MIDI key split, even allowing overlays Easy MIDI learn, with ability to manually configure each MIDI parameter 130+ MIDI parameters MIDI map save, share, preset linkage Velocity control for keyclick, amplitude, and percussion Lockout mode for organ modeling settings & MIDI prefs Create, save, and share unlimited banks and presets 110+ factory presets Stand alone app: audio recording & sharing Compatible with Apple Silicon computers

cn.description: Thick basses, buttery leads, feathery pads — Trooper is a total synth explosion that crams it all and more in a neat little package. It sounds HUGE, yet tweaks easy. It’s coated in analog “fat,” yet bursts with tonal surprises nestled across its controls. Get ready for an all-out sonic assault, because Trooper is here and it's our meanest, beastliest, user-friendliest synth yet! Many of Trooper’s parameters are meant to interact and meld together in novel ways. For example, the oscillator volumes —beyond just acting as mere blend knobs— vary the characteristics of the basic signal depending on how far they are “pushed". The emphasis is on providing warm and round basic tones with lots of variable harmonic content. The primary oscillators are backed by an audible LFO that is both a sound source and a wide frequency range modulator. This lets FM-based sounds to combine with traditional waveforms. A pink/white noise generator helps out pads and percussions, and insidiously changes tonality when added in small amounts. A new filter implementation complements the pugnacity of the signal generators. In its middish settings, the resonance can be characterized as “throaty.” The filter is capable of self-oscillating, and can be controlled via the keyboard. The mated ADSR envelope is shaped to provide tonal ‘immediacy’ and smooth frequency shifts. The amount knob has a wide range that changes the feel and shape of the envelope, especially when pushed above the mid-level. The output stage features a virtual VCA that imparts tones colloquially termed as “fat”. Extra modulation is provided by a non-audible LFO and a dedicated envelope. The LFO offers numerous wave shapes, BPM syncing, and key tracking. Its output is controllable via the mod wheel, velocity, or aftertouch. The Esprit parameter helps deploy some of the Trooper “special sauce.” Highly interactive with the stages preceding it, Esprit is known to be handy in tightening up bass tones, and in adding the "je nais se quois” to presets at large. The Get6 parameter is a one-touch ticket to big, mix-filling synth sounds. So whenever you’re lost in an empty mix…it’s got your six. The arpeggiator inspires rhythms with five algorithms, variable note value, octave range, and gate. The “Texturizer" purveys a wide range of modulation effects that include chorus, flanging, variable comb, resonant delay, and stereo imaging. The BPM-syncable two-tap delay has time and feedback controls per channel, and is tuned a little darker than our usual offerings. Trooper can run in monophonic or polyphonic mode, the latter providing up to 12 voices. Legato is available in either mode. The robust MIDI implementation also includes MPE support, and the synth is able to I/O MIDI performance data. The “MagTouch” virtual controller lets you to play and record (in AUv3 hosts so enabled) over the MPE protocol. MIDI learn is made easy via a visual interface, and users can save, patch-link, and share MIDI CC maps. Bluetooth MIDI input is also supported. The AUv3 implementation lets you to run multiple instances of Trooper in DAWs. Trooper’s fluid UI accommodates a wide variety of screen sizes and view configurations. Feature navigation is designed to be nonintrusive so that parameters can be accessed easily. The iPad implementation supports portrait layout, so that pretty much all is on one screen. Included are over 250 presets that range from deep basses to weird so-and-so's, stopping by many other sounds along the way. The powerful YPAT2 system helps you save, catalog, and share presets with ease. The standalone app provides a “Tapedeck” to record, save, and share your ideas on the quick. It features a built-in looper, and a metronome with configurable time signature. The standalone also features tap tempo, and MIDI clock syncing. DSP is in high resolution 64-bit, with native processing at up to 96kHz.

cn.releaseNotes:
- Added Finder Open With MTP26 support for local video files.
- Added Safari extension support to open YouTube videos, direct video links, and detected page video links in MTP26.
- Added Safari Picture-in-Picture option for protected browser streams, with a clear notice that Safari PiP is not controlled by MTP26’s floating-player behavior.
- Improved local video history: thumbnails are generated and cached, and sandbox permissions are preserved so previously opened local files can play again from Recent or History.
- Added recent videos to the Dock right-click menu.
- Improved History layout to prevent crowded/overlapping video cards.
- Fixed Recent list behavior when opening videos from Finder or Safari extension so the new item appears first while keeping existing recent items.
- Added new global shortcuts for Settings, Playlists, History, Account, Search, and full-screen toggle.
- Updated the Keyboard Shortcuts screen to show the new shortcuts with matching key styling.
cn.description: MiniTube player is a simple video player based on YouTube™ links, you can run videos, and playlists. The Goal of this application is to show you the video as Picture-in-Picture style just like Opera™ and Safari™ browsers, but with some added features such as: the mini-player is flying away from mouse cursor, also you can control the transparency of the player so you can read what is hidden behind it. AAQSoft team

cn.releaseNotes:
Willkommen bei „Über Umwege“

Update V1.2 bringt dir:
GPX Import und eine Bucket List. Importiere deine Lieblingsrouten, lege einen Backlog an und arbeite ihn ab wann immer du willst. Ganz nebenbei trackst du deinen Fortschritt.

Teile deine Erfolge. Nach jeder Tour bekommst du nun eine schicke Übersicht über deine gegangene Strecke und kannst sie direkt mit deinen Freunden teilen.

Außerdem ist es jetzt möglich mit Klick auf einen Button die Karte wieder zu zentrieren. In den EInstellungen gibt es außerdem die Option, dir die Richtungen vorlesen zu lassen.

Über Umwege steht noch ganz am Anfang und ich freue mich auf dein Feedback!
Gemeinsam machen wir das Entdecken noch besser. Weitere tolle Features sind bereits in Planung/Umsetzung.
cn.description: Immer die gleichen Wege? Über Umwege zeigt dir neue Routen durch deine Stadt: basierend auf dem, was du noch nicht erkundet hast. Mach jeden Spaziergang zu einem Abenteuer. Mit Über Umwege entdeckst du deine Umgebung völlig neu. Statt dich auf direktem Weg zum Ziel zu bringen, führt dich die App bewusst über neue Wege; damit du mehr von deiner Stadt siehst. Dabei merkt sich die App, wo du schon warst, und hilft dir dabei, möglichst wenig doppelt zu gehen. Die Daten werden dabei nur auf deinem Gerät gespeichert. Wenn du möchtest, auch über die Private Cloud mit deinen Geräten synchronisiert. Entdecke deine Stadt Stück für Stück Sieh auf der Karte, welche Orte du bereits erkundet hast und wie viel deiner Stadt noch vor dir liegt. Jeder Schritt bringt dich näher an 100%. Navigation neu gedacht Finde neue Wege zu bekannten Zielen Vermeide Strecken, die du schon gegangen bist Lass dich bewusst „über Umwege“ führen Dein Fortschritt wird sichtbar Verfolge, wie viel Prozent deiner Stadt du erkundet hast Sieh deine Wege als Pfade auf der Karte Baue dir dein eigenes Bewegungs-Mosaik Exportiere deine Fortschritte als schicke Karte im png oder pdf Format. Perfekt zum ausdrucken als Poster Mach mehr aus jedem Spaziergang Ob kurzer Weg zum Supermarkt oder langer Walk durch die Stadt mit „Über Umwege“ wird jeder Weg interessanter. Bleib motiviert mit Streaks. Setze dir selbst gewählte Ziele und versuche sie jeden Tag zu erreichen. Wenn es mal nicht klappt ist das nicht schlimm. In dieser App gibt keine nervigen Eulen die dich jeden Tag nerven. Die Erkundung ist das Ziel. Wenn du es einmal probiert hast, läuft es sich ganz von allein. Importiere GPX Daten, einzeln oder eine ganze Menge, lege daraus eine Bucket List an und laufe sie ganz stressfrei ab. Teile direkt deine Erfolge mit Freunden. Nach jeder Tour bekommst du eine schicke Übersicht zum Teilen und Motivieren. Lade jetzt Über Umwege und entdecke deine Stadt neu.

cn.description: Discover your perfect soundscape with SleepTune. whether you are looking to improve your own sleep, focus on work, or help your baby drift off to dreamland, SleepTune provides the ultimate audio experience. Mix and match high-quality sounds to create your unique ambiance, or choose from our specialized library for relaxation and focus. CREATE YOUR OWN MIX Become your own audio engineer. Combine sounds simultaneously from our extensive library. Wide Variety: Choose from Rain, Nature, City vibes, Fans, ASMR, Melodies, and more. Precision Control: Adjust the volume of each individual sound to find the perfect balance. Save & Cloud: Save your favorite mixes to your personal library and back them up to the Cloud. EXPORT & SHARE Take your sounds with you! SleepTune allows you to render your custom mixes into 5-minute high-quality audio files. Export them to your files, share them with friends, or use them in other apps. SMART TIMER Drift off without worry. Set a custom sleep timer (from 5 minutes to 3 hours), and SleepTune will gently fade out the audio when the time is up, saving your battery while you sleep. KEY FEATURES: Over 50+ High-Quality Sounds (Rain, Thunder, White Noise, Pink Noise, Brown Noise, and more). Beautiful, Dark-Mode first design for low eye strain at night. Background Playback: Keep your audio playing while using other apps or when your screen is locked. Offline Support: Enjoy your favorite sounds without an internet connection. Download SleepTune today and rediscover the power of sound. Privacy Policy & Terms and Conditions: https://github.com/estersr/App-Policies

cn.description: Typin 是一款轻量、克制的写作与笔记 App，面向开发者、写作者，以及随时记录灵感的人。 你可以用纯文本快速落笔，也可以切换到 Markdown 并实时渲染，让结构立刻清晰可读。支持局域网实时同步，在电脑浏览器上继续编辑。 核心体验 编辑与输入 纯文本 / Markdown 双模式，一键切换，并记住你的偏好 Markdown 语法高亮：标题、加粗/斜体、代码、列表、引用等清晰可辨 Markdown 快捷工具栏：常用符号一键输入，长按显示提示 标题跳转：Markdown 模式下快速定位到任意标题 列表更顺手：回车自动续写列表 手势辅助排版：左右滑动快速调整标题级别与列表缩进 智能复制功能：无焦点复制全部、有焦点弹出选项菜单、选中时复制选中内容 丰富的文本操作：复制当前行、删除当前行、粘贴并替换、清空文档 实时同步 局域网实时同步：在电脑浏览器上访问并同步编辑 可选密码鉴权，保护你的数据安全 同步状态实时显示，连接状态一目了然 网页客户端支持多语言和深浅色模式 多文档管理 抽屉式文档列表，快速切换 文档置顶功能，重要文档保持在顶部 回收站：误删文档可恢复 支持重命名、删除、分享操作 按修改时间和置顶状态智能排序 个性化设置 字体大小可调：小 / 中 / 大 / 超大 行间距选择：紧凑 / 标准 / 宽松 主题模式：浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统 Markdown 按钮显示：图标 / 文本 自动保存间隔可配置 其他特性 自动保存与保存状态提示，写得安心 导出分享：支持 .md / .txt 格式 键盘控制：收起键盘或快速跳转到底部 键盘弹起时工具栏自动浮起，编辑区域自适应 应用内语言切换：支持简体中文、繁體中文、English、日本語、한국어、Deutsch、Français

cn.trackName: 明朝当官模拟器-俺在大明当首辅
cn.releaseNotes:
全新的名称和图标，并包含以下精彩内容：
1、现已上线全新剧情的历史事件：1449·北京保卫战！
此事件分为多个部分，根据文治、武功、翰林路线，您可体验筹集粮草、筹集火铳、审问内奸、防卫京师、决战德胜门等多个趣味任务，若最终成功击杀也先之弟：孛罗，将可获得快速升迁、丹书铁券等奖励。
若在此事件中击杀瓦剌首领也先，则可直升朝廷二品大员，同时解锁“历史改变者”称号。
2、新赠官员月俸、家产系统，可在模拟器内通过多种渠道获得家资家产；
3、优化部分细节，修复部分本地化语言的翻译问题。
cn.description: 《明朝当官模拟器》是一款以明朝科举与官场为背景的沉浸式文字策略模拟器。你将从一名普通童生起步，按院试、乡试、会试、殿试的顺序逐级应考，在限时答题中博取功名、赢得声望、解锁称号，体验「范进中举」式的逆袭，直至金殿传胨、进士及第、初授官职。 及第入仕后，模拟并未止步于考场。你可升堂审理民事刑名，或参与明朝的重大历史事件！在田宅、婚姻、债务等案件中明察秋毫，或以武功路线，在兵务、军政中建功立业！亦可入馆考校史料、修理国史，凭政绩与声望沿知县文治线或翰林修史线升迁，从七品知县一路擢升至内阁首辅，位极人臣。你还可以参与明朝的重大历史事件，改变历史进程！ 若厌倦了案牍劳形，还可踏入「奇遇」：纵情山水，在随机游历中增益声望、求得佳人、收集宝物；温故知新，复习明朝政治、地理、文学掌故；挑战永乐大典，在限时答题中博得名声。佳人与宝物皆收录于「家庭」，见证你的明朝人生足迹。 本模拟器支持进度存档、称号展示与多种内购助力，兼顾硬核考据与轻松体验。无论你是历史爱好者、策略模拟爱好者，还是只想在碎片时间里体验一段完整的「明朝升级史」，《明朝高考模拟器》都能带你穿越六百年，亲手书写属于自己的功名传奇！ 本App包含付费功能： 1、直接通过考试，价格8元人民币 购买后，您将直接通过当前考试 2、3次继续考试的机会，价格6元人民币 购买后，您将获得3次继续考试的机会，无需从头来过 3、3次继续游历的机会，价格6元人民币 购买后，您将获得3次继续游历的机会，无需从头来过 4、10次继续考核官职的机会，价格6元人民币 购买后，您将获得10次继续考核的机会，无需从头来过 5、永久会员，价格68元 购买后，您将解锁“穿越者”称号。可在参加科举、审理案件、修理国史等任务，快速获得正确答案。 用户协议地址：https://docs.qq.com/doc/DUWpRZU54QW14a0xC 隐私政策地址：https://docs.qq.com/doc/DUUJueWdHQXFTb0NX

cn.releaseNotes:
Willkommen bei „Über Umwege“

Update V1.2 bringt dir:
GPX Import und eine Bucket List. Importiere deine Lieblingsrouten, lege einen Backlog an und arbeite ihn ab wann immer du willst. Ganz nebenbei trackst du deinen Fortschritt.

Teile deine Erfolge. Nach jeder Tour bekommst du nun eine schicke Übersicht über deine gegangene Strecke und kannst sie direkt mit deinen Freunden teilen.

Außerdem ist es jetzt möglich mit Klick auf einen Button die Karte wieder zu zentrieren. In den EInstellungen gibt es außerdem die Option, dir die Richtungen vorlesen zu lassen.

Über Umwege steht noch ganz am Anfang und ich freue mich auf dein Feedback!
Gemeinsam machen wir das Entdecken noch besser. Weitere tolle Features sind bereits in Planung/Umsetzung.
cn.description: Immer die gleichen Wege? Über Umwege zeigt dir neue Routen durch deine Stadt: basierend auf dem, was du noch nicht erkundet hast. Mach jeden Spaziergang zu einem Abenteuer. Mit Über Umwege entdeckst du deine Umgebung völlig neu. Statt dich auf direktem Weg zum Ziel zu bringen, führt dich die App bewusst über neue Wege; damit du mehr von deiner Stadt siehst. Dabei merkt sich die App, wo du schon warst, und hilft dir dabei, möglichst wenig doppelt zu gehen. Die Daten werden dabei nur auf deinem Gerät gespeichert. Wenn du möchtest, auch über die Private Cloud mit deinen Geräten synchronisiert. Entdecke deine Stadt Stück für Stück Sieh auf der Karte, welche Orte du bereits erkundet hast und wie viel deiner Stadt noch vor dir liegt. Jeder Schritt bringt dich näher an 100%. Navigation neu gedacht Finde neue Wege zu bekannten Zielen Vermeide Strecken, die du schon gegangen bist Lass dich bewusst „über Umwege“ führen Dein Fortschritt wird sichtbar Verfolge, wie viel Prozent deiner Stadt du erkundet hast Sieh deine Wege als Pfade auf der Karte Baue dir dein eigenes Bewegungs-Mosaik Exportiere deine Fortschritte als schicke Karte im png oder pdf Format. Perfekt zum ausdrucken als Poster Mach mehr aus jedem Spaziergang Ob kurzer Weg zum Supermarkt oder langer Walk durch die Stadt mit „Über Umwege“ wird jeder Weg interessanter. Bleib motiviert mit Streaks. Setze dir selbst gewählte Ziele und versuche sie jeden Tag zu erreichen. Wenn es mal nicht klappt ist das nicht schlimm. In dieser App gibt keine nervigen Eulen die dich jeden Tag nerven. Die Erkundung ist das Ziel. Wenn du es einmal probiert hast, läuft es sich ganz von allein. Importiere GPX Daten, einzeln oder eine ganze Menge, lege daraus eine Bucket List an und laufe sie ganz stressfrei ab. Teile direkt deine Erfolge mit Freunden. Nach jeder Tour bekommst du eine schicke Übersicht zum Teilen und Motivieren. Lade jetzt Über Umwege und entdecke deine Stadt neu.

cn.releaseNotes:
This release introduces Podcast Channels support and a new Statistics sheet showing listening activity and goals. The Episode view has been redesigned, and the Now Playing screen now features an animated background. The Sleep Timer and playback speed picker have been reworked, and the home screen has a new customization editor.

OpenID Connect authentication has been fixed, and library lookup is more reliable, with better genre handling and tag support. Settings have been redesigned, and iPadOS layout, accessibility, and CarPlay have all received polish, including a fix for physical wheel buttons that didn't work in some circumstances. Internally, event propagation has moved from NotificationCenter to Combine.

Other changes include:

- New Bookmark Export App Intent
- Updated Intents and Shortcuts support
- Better image aspect ratio handling
- New marquee text for long titles
- Increased offline mode timeout
- Convenience Download subsystem rework
- More WebSocket events for progress, sessions, and item updates
- Memory leak fixes
- Under-the-hood refactors and project structure cleanup
- Translation updates
- Various bug fixes
cn.description: ShelfPlayer is a powerful iOS application for listening to audiobooks and podcasts, designed for users with self-hosted Audiobookshelf libraries. Built in Swift 6 for iOS 18+, ShelfPlayer is fast, privacy-respecting, and deeply integrated with the Apple ecosystem. ShelfPlayer does not include any media content. A running Audiobookshelf instance is required to use the app. Features Unified audiobook and podcast app: A single, native experience for audiobooks, podcasts, episodes, authors, narrators, series, collections, and playlists. Multi-server support: Works with multiple Audiobookshelf servers and libraries at the same time. Flexible authentication: Supports both username/password and OpenID sign-in. Custom request headers: Additional HTTP headers can be configured for advanced setups. Listen Now: Continue listening and discover content across connected libraries. cn.description: Stop forgetting what you read, watch, and study. LearnBack turns everyday learning into long-term memory. Capture what you discover, recall it in your own words, and review it at the right time with active recall and spaced repetition. Whether you are preparing for exams, learning a new skill, reading books, watching educational videos, or collecting ideas, LearnBack helps you build knowledge that stays with you. REMEMBER BY RECALLING Learning is not only about consuming more information. LearnBack asks you to retrieve what you learned in your own words, helping you move from passive scrolling to active learning. CAPTURE BY TEXT OR VOICE Save a quick written recall or record your thoughts while reading, studying, commuting, or watching a video. Add a title and tag so every idea stays organized. BUILD PERSONAL FLASHCARDS Turn your own recalls into flashcards based on the ideas that matter to you. Your cards come from your learning—not a generic deck. REVIEW AT THE RIGHT TIME Use spaced repetition to revisit important ideas before they fade. Rate each review as Again, Hard, Good, or Easy, and keep strengthening your memory over time. YOUR LEARNING TIMELINE Browse your recalls by date, replay voice notes, revisit written insights, and build a personal history of what you have learned. INSIGHTS THAT KEEP YOU MOVING Track your daily streak, recall activity, review progress, and learning categories. See small steps become a lasting habit. LEARN WITHOUT BURNING OUT Optional eye-care reminders support the 20-20-20 rule, while stretching reminders encourage you to move during long learning sessions. PRIVATE BY DESIGN No account required. No cloud storage. No external servers. Your learning stays on your device, and LearnBack does not collect your data. PERFECT FOR Students and exam preparation Books, articles, courses, and podcasts Language and professional learning Coding and technical concepts Lifelong learners and curious minds Anyone tired of forgetting useful ideas Learn less passively. Recall more actively. Remember for longer. Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ Privacy Policy: https://learnback.lovable.app/

cn.description: ARE YOU DATING A WALKING RED FLAG? Welcome to RoastCam, the ultimate AI-powered Vibe Check. Whether you are investigating a suspicious crush, roasting your best friend, or just want to expose the truth, RoastCam is your pocket detective. We use advanced (and totally judgmental) computer vision to scan faces in real-time. The app analyzes micro-expressions and energy levels to generate a savage diagnosis instantly. WHAT ROASTCAM DOES AI FACE SCANNER Point the camera at a friend. Our scanner locks onto their face and "scans" their vibe using our proprietary, highly judgmental Red Flag engine. MICRO-EXPRESSION ANALYSIS The app detects facial features and simulates a high-tech analysis of their energy levels to generate a savage diagnosis instantly. SAVAGE DIAGNOSES Is he a Ghoster? Is she Toxic? The app reveals the brutal truth with 3D stickers and harsh titles. OFFICIAL SIMP LICENSES Once the scan is complete, generate an official Simp License. It includes their photo, offense, severity level, and restrictions. It looks like a real federal ID, perfect for group chats. VIDEO EVIDENCE Record the entire scanning process. The app saves a high-quality video with the diagnosis card overlay, ready to be shared on TikTok, Instagram, or Snapchat. KEY FEATURES Real-time face detection and tracking. Over 500 (!!!!!!!) unique Red Flags and personality traits. High-quality video recording with AR overlays. Customizable ID cards with randomized titles and restrictions. Instant sharing to social media. Haptic feedback and sound effects for maximum impact. HOW TO USE 1. Find a victim and point the camera at them. 2. Wait for the AI to lock on and analyze their soul. 3. Watch the verdict appear above their head. 4. Generate their Simp License and share it with the world. RoastCam is designed for entertainment purposes only. Please roast responsibly. DISCLAIMER RoastCam is intended for entertainment and comedic purposes only. While this app uses real Computer Vision technology for face tracking and detection, the "analysis" of micro-expressions, energy levels, and personality traits is a simulation generated for fun. No actual psychological or biometric evaluation is performed. Please roast responsibly.

cn.description: LandMeter 将任何地图变成一个快速的土地、田地和庭院测量工具。在地图上点击点即可测量面积、周长和距离，并立即以英亩、平方英尺、公顷或平方米读取结果。无需账户，无需注册——只需打开地图即可开始测量。 测量任何土地，随时随地 点击地图勾勒田地、庭院、地块、屋顶或工作现场的轮廓 闭合形状后立即查看面积和周长 测量点对点或沿路径的距离 在标准、卫星和混合地图样式之间切换，以获得更清晰的背景信息 适用于世界各地——无需地块数据库 专为实际工作打造 农民和牧场主——以英亩为单位测量田地、牧场和围场的大小 房地产和房主——在销售或项目前检查地块和庭院大小 景观美化和草坪护理——按平方英尺报价 围栏——以英尺为单位测量周长 屋顶和太阳能——估算屋顶和地面面积 土地买家和猎人——在现场评估地块或食物种植区的大小 您需要的每一个单位 英亩、平方英尺、平方米、公顷、英里、公里和英尺。一键切换单位并立即转换。 保存、查看和分享 将重要的地点和测量结果本地保存在您的设备上 查看坐标和几何细节 为您测量的任何区域创建无人机风格的航拍或飞行视频 与客户或团队分享地图、快照或无人机视频 隐私设计 无需账户 位置权限是可选的 保存的地点和收藏夹保留在您的设备上 本应用不显示业主姓名、地契持有人或土地登记所有权 为什么选择 LANDMETER 大多数土地工具将基本的测量功能隐藏在登录或订阅之后。LandMeter 让您打开地图即可立即测量——快速、简单且真实。 包含土耳其地块查询 在土耳其，LandMeter 还包括在公共源服务提供覆盖范围的情况下的地籍地块查询。在支持的地点，您可以点击地图或通过地块参考进行搜索，以查看地块边界、面积、周长和相关的地图背景。 重要提示 LandMeter 是一个独立的测量和地图实用工具。它不是政府服务、土地登记处、测量、工程报告、法律意见、估值工具，也不是所有权或产权的官方来源。测量结果、坐标、地块边界和地图数据仅供参考，可能存在近似、不完整、不可用、延迟或与官方记录不同的情况。在做出重要的土地、房产、规划、建筑、法律、安全或购买决策时，请务必向官方来源和合格的专业人士核实。 隐私政策: https://perfect-notebook-2c8.notion.site/Privacy-Policy-37f904d8b4fe804f86bed24e4103d62d 使用条款: https://perfect-notebook-2c8.notion.site/Terms-of-Use-37f904d8b4fe8019878bf220f01b3506 支持: https://parselim.app

cn.description: FrameLens is the ultimate HD video player that lets you search what you play. Watch all your favorite movies, MP4s, and media in stunning high definition, and instantly extract text or find objects on screen with a built-in OCR lens. Ever spotted a cool outfit in a movie and wanted to buy it? Seen a sign, document, or quote in a video lecture you wanted to look up? FrameLens makes it effortless. It’s an all-in-one media library and a powerful visual search engine built into a single, seamless video player. HOW IT WORKS Play: Open any video file from your media library or import via links. Pause: Stop on the exact frame you want to explore. Scan: Tap detected text (OCR) or draw a box around any object on screen. Search: Get instant web results right inside the player. KEY FEATURES All-Format HD Video Player Play MP4, MKV, and all major video formats smoothly in high definition. Enjoy a premium, seamless viewing experience with intuitive player controls. Interactive OCR Lens (Text Recognition) Instantly detect words, captions, signs, and labels on screen. Tap any word to copy it or search the web. No typing, no screenshots, and no manual transcription. Visual Object Search See a landmark, product, or outfit you like? Draw a box around it, and FrameLens will find visually similar results on the web in seconds. Built-In Media Library Easily organize, manage, and browse your entire local video collection. A clean, all-in-one hub for your movies, screen recordings, and clips. Seamless In-App Browser Search results open in a picture-in-picture window right inside the player, so you never lose your place in the movie. Search, browse, and jump right back to watching. Search History & Saved Frames Every scan is automatically saved. Quickly jump back to the exact video timestamp of your past searches, or save your favorite frames directly to your gallery. WHO IT'S FOR Students & Researchers: Easily capture and search text from recorded lectures, slide decks, and online tutorials. Shoppers: Identify clothing, gadgets, and decor directly from video clips. Cinephiles & Fans: Look up actors, filming locations, and props in real-time. Anyone looking for a smarter, more powerful way to watch and interact with their videos. PREMIUM UNLOCK Get unlimited searches and a faster, ad-free experience. Lifetime Access: $29.99 (One-time payment) Yearly Subscription: $17.99 Weekly Access: $4.99 SUPPORT & LEGAL Privacy Policy: https://redizeuz.com/privacy Terms of Service: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

cn.releaseNotes:
本次更新带来更灵活的点位显示，让勘测、热力图和导出内容更加清晰。

- 勘测时可选择显示点位名称或当前指标值。
- 热力图可显示点位名称、当前热力图指标值，或隐藏点位查看更干净的图面。
- 导出 PNG 图片和 PDF 时，可选择是否显示点位，并显示名称或当前页面对应的指标值。
- 可在设置中保存勘测、热力图和导出的默认点位显示偏好。
cn.description: 络图（NetGraph）是一款面向网络工程师、IT 运维、安装商和弱电集成商的 Wi-Fi 现场勘测工具。 通过楼层图、现场采样和多指标热力图，直观呈现无线网络覆盖与实际使用体验，帮助发现弱信号、信道干扰、漫游异常、延迟和丢包等问题，并生成可交付的图片或 PDF 报告。 【项目与图纸】 按客户、项目和楼层管理勘测数据 从相册或文件导入楼层图 校准图纸比例尺，设置场景和检测精度 创建目标 Wi-Fi，管理采样点和测量记录 在图纸上放置路由器、AP、AC 等网络设备 通过项目包导入、导出和归档数据 兼容旧版本项目文件 【现场勘测】 支持直接采样和规划采样 在图纸上创建、移动和管理采样点 为采样点添加照片、备注和重采样标记 点位可显示名称或当前指标值 采样数据与图纸位置关联，方便复查和对比 【Wi-Fi 检测】 Mac 提供更完整的 Wi-Fi 扫描与分析能力，可查看： 信号强度、信噪比和噪声 信道、频段、BSSID 和链路速率 Wi-Fi 标准、安全性和 IP 信息 周边 AP、信道占用和干扰情况 iPhone 和 iPad 可配合快捷指令读取增强 Wi-Fi 指标，满足现场移动采样需求。 【网络体验测试】 除无线信号外，还可以检测实际网络体验： 公网和局域网延迟 丢包率 下载吞吐 上传吞吐 支持配置公网或局域网测试地址，帮助判断问题来自无线覆盖、局域网还是网络出口。 【Wi-Fi 漫游测试】 观察设备在不同 AP 之间的切换过程 记录 AP 切换、延迟、丢包和连接事件 保存并查看漫游测试历史 导出漫游测试 PDF 适用于企业办公、酒店、学校、商场和仓库等多 AP 无线网络环境。 【多指标热力图】 根据楼层图和采样数据生成热力图，支持信号强度、信噪比、噪声、链路速率、下载与上传吞吐、延迟、丢包率等指标。 热力图支持： 多窗格指标对比 指标说明 自定义颜色方案 显示点位名称 显示当前热力图指标值 隐藏点位，查看干净的热力图 【图片与 PDF 导出】 导出 PNG 热力图 导出包含多个楼层和指标的多页 PDF 每个楼层和指标生成独立图片或 PDF 页面 自定义导出的楼层、指标和文件命名顺序 选择是否显示采样点、网络设备和指标说明 点位可显示名称或当前页面对应的指标值 【支持 Mac、iPhone 和 iPad】 三端均支持项目管理、图纸导入、现场采样、网络体验测试、漫游测试、热力图分析以及图片和 PDF 导出，并针对不同设备优化操作布局。 Mac 额外提供更完整的 Wi-Fi 扫描、信道占用和周边干扰分析能力；iPhone 和 iPad 更便于现场走动采样、复测和展示。 络图支持中文和英文界面及深色模式，让 Wi-Fi 勘测、问题分析和报告交付集中在一个清晰的项目工作流中。 使用条款（EULA）： https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ 服务条款： https://silentblankpage.github.io/NetGraph-terms.html

cn.description: You will be able to explore your eating habits visually and improve your eating habits. No calories and no numbers are shown in the app! Features: + Beautifully minimalist food diary app + In-App Camera And Filter + No calories No Pressure + Visualizes all your diets and shows your diet balance clearly! + Crazy and Interactive Foody Face + Learn how to eat mindfully and correctly right now! Don’t make Foody Face angry! Tap download right now! The inspiration behind FoodyLife is that nowadays people pay little attention to what they eat and often eat unhealthy food. Although there are many similar apps on the market (e.g. Fitness App, Calorie counter...), most of them focus mainly on “numbers”, such as how many calories the user has eaten and how long the user should exercise to get rid of those calories, or sending the user notifications when they should get up to exercise or if they have eaten too much. FoodyLife’ is an app that helps users track their daily diet by allowing them to keep their own food diary. The app shows neither calories nor numbers; instead, users have only to take a picture, enter their diet information, then they are able their overall diet balance. It is very simple and highly effective. Users can explore their eating habits visually, improving self-consciousness about eating habits.

cn.description: Resume Builder is here to help you creating a professional and impressive resume in minutes. Whether you're a recent graduate or a seasoned professional, our innovative app is designed to help you craft the perfect resume that showcases your skills, experience, and unique qualifications, all with a few taps on your mobile devices. With Resume Builder, say goodbye to the daunting task of formatting and structuring your resume. Our app takes the guesswork out of the equation by providing you with an intuitive interface that seamlessly guides you through each step of the process. From choosing the right tenplate to cutsomize your sections and content, we ensure that you create a visually appealing and professional resume that stands out from the crowd. We understand that a resume for a first-time job seeker will differ from that of a seasoned professional. Resume Builder offers a wide range of templates and customizable options to meet the unique needs of all individuals. Whether you're fresh out of college, transitioning industries, or aiming for a higher management role, our app has the flexibility to adapt to your specific career goals. Easily modify font styles, colors, and layouts to personalize your resume and make it truly represent you. Whether you want to add a touch of creativity or maintain a clean and professional look, our app ensures your resume reflects your unique personality and captures the attention of potential employers. Resume Builder provides you with a range of templates that are specifically designed to suit different industries and roles, giving you all the necessary tools to create a perfect resume that highlights your skills and achievements. Export file in a variety of formats. You can save it to your device or share it directly with employers, recruiters, or networking contacts. No more fumbling with file conversions or worrying about compatibility issues. With Resume Builder, sharing your professional accomplishments has never been easier. Features: Wide range of templates specifically designed to suit different industries and roles. Customizable options for fonts, colors and styles. Built-in sharing function for easy sending and printing. User-friendly interface and intuitive navigation system form for easy editing and updating. Download resume in PDF format. Creating and editing your resume is further simplified with our app's intuitive navigation system and user-friendly interface. You can easily edit and update your resume, seeing your progress in real-time as you add your professional experience and qualifications.

cn.description: 一目了然查看温度、湿度、气压和不适指数。 一款以模拟仪表风格呈现每日空气状态的天气信息应用， 通过直观而优雅的方式展示环境变化。 基于当前位置，您可以通过精美的仪表盘界面查看室外温度、体感温度、湿度、 气压变化以及不适指数（DI）。 [主要功能] 精美的模拟仪表盘设计 查看当前温度和体感温度 (支持摄氏 / 华氏温度) 通过湿度计了解舒适程度 用迷你趋势图查看短期变化 支持气压计（hPa / inHg / mmHg） 显示海平面气压和地面气压 24小时气压趋势（上升 · 下降 · 稳定） 计算不适指数（DI） 支持小组件 支持 Apple Watch 应用及多种表盘复杂功能 [你知道吗？] 不适指数（DI）由 Thom 于 1959 年提出，是通过气温和湿度组合来衡量人体感受到的炎热和闷热程度的指标。 气压数据根据世界气象组织（WMO）标准换算为海平面气压显示。支持的设备还可以通过内置传感器测量地面气压。 在支持 GPS 的 iPhone 和 iPad 上，可以根据当前位置附近的最新观测数据提供更准确的信息。 手动添加城市后，即使没有 GPS 也可以使用。 [请注意] 本应用不是通过室内传感器测量房间温度的应用。 本应用根据当前位置提供室外温度、湿度和气压等天气信息。 [联系我们与支持] 如果您在使用过程中遇到问题或有改进建议，请随时联系我们： support@morethan.net

cn.description: 零基础韩语入门 App —— 四十音、口语、听力、跟读、AI 解析,一个 App 全搞定。 【核心模块】 一、发音:韩语 40 字母 + 每日精选 四十音点读卡,元音、辅音双视图,哪里不会点哪里。原汁原味的标准发音,配合笔画动画与口型示例,告别"哑巴韩语"。 每日精选,每日更新一句高频场景句。 单词与拼写,从字母拼读开始,渐进式词汇与拼写练习,配合可点击例句。 二、口语:700+ 高频短句,覆盖 7 大场景 按真实使用频率筛选,覆盖日常礼貌、交通、住宿、就餐、购物、旅游、其他 7 大场景。 口语列表分类清晰,支持搜索与收藏。一键收藏易忘句子,随时回看。练习模块内置录音器对比发音,纠正薄弱环节。热力图可视化每日练习频次,养成长效习惯。 三、听力:句子拆解 + 话题训练 听句训练将长句拆分为短句,逐句播放、跟读、听写。听力话题精选多场景听力素材,配套 AI 解析。 AI 智能解析,上传一段韩语,AI 自动拆分语法成分、词性、用法与中文释义,让每一句韩语都能被真正看懂。 【适用人群】 赴韩留学 / 旅游 / 工作的零基础学习者;看韩剧、听 K-Pop 想听懂更多台词的粉丝;因工作需要掌握基础韩语口语的职场人士;中高级韩语学习者查漏补缺。

cn.description: 一个帮助日语初学者系统学习日语五十音、基础口语与日常对话的实用工具。 随身携带的日语老师，从五十音入门到流利对话，一步到位。 涵盖日常生活中的高频场景——商店、旅行、酒店、餐馆等，操作简便、界面直观、内容丰富。 应用功能 （1）日语五十音 完整的五十音图学习，包含清音、浊音、拗音三大板块。每个假名均配有标准发音、例词演示与手写训练，帮助初学者扎实掌握日语字母的基础。 （2）基础口语与短句 精选日常高频口语短句，按礼仪、交通、住宿、饮食、购物、旅行等七大场景分类。每句均支持音频播放、跟读录音与收藏，配合口语练习热力图，让学习过程一目了然。 （3）AI 情景对话 内置多种真实对话场景（如餐厅点餐、酒店入住、问路等），与 AI 进行沉浸式日语对话练习。支持多轮交互，即时反馈，打造接近母语环境的口语训练体验。 （4）每日一句 每日推送一句精选日语短句，附带 AI 智能解析，从语法、词汇、文化背景多维度拆解。支持慢速与常速播放，适合碎片化学习。 （5）听句与单词卡 逐词拆分播放句子，强化听力理解；每日单词卡片帮助积累核心词汇。 （6）日语数字转换 输入阿拉伯数字即可实时转换为日语汉字、平假名与罗马音，支持 TTS 朗读。内置 0-10 万常用数字快捷入口，方便快速查阅。 （7）日本文化与色彩 内置日本城市地图浏览和日本传统色彩图鉴，在学习语言的同时感受日本文化之美。 （8）口语练习录音 支持句子跟读录音与回放，随时对比自己的发音与标准发音，持续改进口语表达。 （9）听力训练 丰富的听力素材覆盖日常对话、场景对话等，支持原文与译文对照学习，逐步提升日语语感与听力理解能力。

cn.trackCensoredName: MindFit - 大脑训练与认知提升
cn.releaseNotes:
• 斯特鲁普任务新增「字义模式」：忽略文字颜色、根据词义选择颜色，两个模式的成绩分开统计
• 中文刺激词改为单字显示（如"红"而非"红色"），挑战更纯粹
• N-back 点击「匹配」后立即进入下一题，训练节奏更流畅
• 新游戏「多目标追踪」在首页置顶并加上 NEW 标识
• 修复已知问题，提升稳定性
cn.trackName: MindFit - 大脑训练与认知提升
cn.description: MindFit - 您专属的大脑健身房 在信息爆炸的时代，专注力成为了稀缺资源。MindFit基于认知神经科学原理，为您提供个性化、科学化的大脑训练方案，帮助您在学习和工作中保持最佳状态。 核心训练项目： 工作记忆训练 (N-back) 通过经典的N-back任务，系统训练您的工作记忆容量。动态难度调节确保训练始终处于最佳挑战区间，帮助您更好地处理多任务信息，提升学习效率。 注意力训练 (Stroop) 基于1935年Stroop经典实验，训练您的抑制控制能力。有效提升在面对干扰信息时的专注度，帮助您在会议和深度工作中保持注意力集中。 认知灵活性 (任务切换) 通过快速任务切换训练，提升大脑的认知灵活性。增强您在多任务环境下的思维转换能力，提高工作效率和适应能力。 视觉搜索训练 (苏尔特方格) 经典的视觉搜索任务，训练您的视觉注意力和信息处理能力。提升在复杂视觉环境中快速定位关键信息的能力。 反应时间训练 测量您的反应时间，帮助您识别和减少延迟。提升在快速决策和紧急情况中的响应速度。 短时记忆训练 (闪记) 通过经典的闪记任务，快速、视觉化、多感官刺激的方式，激活右脑，提高瞬时记忆、照相记忆能力，训练专注力、观察力与反应力，从而加速学习进程，高效记忆词汇、公式等知识。 多目标追踪训练 (MOT) 基于经典的多目标追踪范式，记住目标小球，并在它们停止移动后点选。训练您的选择性注意与持续追踪能力，帮助您在驾驶、球类运动等动态复杂环境中牢牢锁定关键目标。无尽挑战与固定关卡两种模式，适合不同训练阶段。 适用人群： 学生群体 - 提升学习效率，增强记忆力 职场人士 - 提高工作效率，改善专注力 中老年群体 - 保持大脑活力，延缓认知衰退 任何希望提升大脑机能的人士 每天15分钟，让MindFit成为您大脑健康的好伙伴！

cn.description: Create professional Blues tracks to your own chords in minutes with the award-winning SessionBand app - the world’s only chord-based loop app. For Blues musicians and songwriters, this unique app is the ultimate tool for jamming and writing, with full and complete Blues tracks just minutes away! It's also simple enough for non-musicians to create their own great-sounding, royalty-free music with. “Remarkably polished“ Forbes “Extraordinarily useful“ Jamie Cullum “Create like a master“ Engadget With over 16,000 stunning, chord-based Blues loops (included) individually recorded by 4 of the world's very best session musicians, SessionBand Blues instantly converts the chords you select into great sounding audio – wherever you are and whatever your ability. There are 15 different classic Blues styles included. Every single loop carefully engineered so you can instantly create your own tracks in those styles: from a slow Bonamassa 12/8 and a Muddy Waters shuffle, through various ballads, Texas and Blue Line shuffles all the way to uptempo Delta blues and Bluegrass. And there's a host of pro features like auto-transpose, automated mixing, one-touch live recording, and Audiobus compatibility - allowing you to seamlessly export our unique content into other top music apps like Garageband. It has never been easier or quicker to create your own studio quality music even if you can't play a note! If you love Blues – you will love SessionBand Blues! A Top 10 paid music app in 66 countries since launch. Hear exactly how SessionBand Blues sounds by watching the video at sessionbandapp.com The fastest way to create studio-quality Blues music... Simply pick one of 15 awesome Blues styles Choose your chords Stretch or shorten loops in seconds Build up a full track in minutes Instantly hear your track across the other playing styles and tempos Auto-transpose your entire track (not electronic pitch shift!) Mix your track (manual or automated) Adjust track tempo (+/- 15%) Record direct to audio Copy straight to other music apps Share with the world! Get 4 of the world's top session musicians playing on your tracks... Drums – Geoff Dugmore (Rod Stewart, Tina Turner, Taj Mahal, Newton Faulkner, Richard Ashcroft, Leona Lewis, Jimmy Page, Robbie Williams, Dido, Natalie Imbruglia, Steve Winwood...) Guitars – Adam Goldsmith (Brian May, Meat Loaf, Robbie Williams, Elton John, Will Young, Ronan Keating, Beverley Knight, Gloria Estefan...) Bass – Geoff Gascoyne (Sting, Georgie Fame, Van Morrison, Bill Bruford, Gloria Estefan, Jamie Cullum...) Keyboards – Tom Cawley (Jack DeJohnette, Charlie Watts, Stacey Kent, Andrea Bocelli, Peter Gabriel...) Anyone can create and release professional Blues tracks with SessionBand... No musical experience required Simple, intuitive interface allows easy chord/loop selection and manipulation Audition loops as you go Build a full track in minutes with all-new 'Track Builder' Highly educational and great fun Create great sounding real Blues music on the move... All loops reside within the downloaded app No internet access required once the app is downloaded Create studio-quality music absolutely anywhere! Detailed Product Information 15 Blues styles in tempo order: Slow 12/8; Slow Shuffle; Slow Blues Rock; Medium Shuffle; Blues Rock Ballad; Slow 6/4; 70s Medium Blues Rock; Texas Shuffle; Funky Blues; Medium 6/4; Blues Line Shuffle; Rock n Roll; Fast Shuffle; Mississippi Blues; Bluegrass Tempos from 60bpm to 180bpm 10 chord variations for every root note in all 15 styles: 6; 7; 7(b9); 9; 7(#9); maj7; m7(b5); m9; m7; maj 'stop' Each of the 15 styles includes 15 alternative drum grooves and drum fills in addition to the 'main' drum pattern for that style The exclusive musical content in this app is not duplicated in any of the other SessionBand apps All loops are offered royalty-free and can be used freely in your own works

OK啊也是一次大版本更新好吧。

- 现在完整支持了不同的实况类型，并支持关闭实况。
- 现在支持拖动重新排序个人相簿列表。
- 大幅提升删除功能的速度，现在不会在转圈状态卡住了。
- 新增视频倍速播放。
- 去雾功能增加强度调整。
- 增加跳转到系统照片 APP 功能。

- 改善了一系列 iOS17/18 下的兼容性 bug。
- 修复了原先一系列闪退的 bug。

诚挚感谢大家的反馈 :)

cn.description: “相册整理，应当发生在每一次自然浏览里。” AirPhotos 是一款为 iPhone 设计的，功能强大的相册管理 App。 它在 Apple 相册体验上补齐上滑删除、快捷归类到相簿、剪辑视频为实况照片和视频后台压缩能力，并能让您像刷短视频一样在整个图库中漫游。 【主要功能】 智能三分类 智能分类来自前后置摄像头、屏幕截取或第三方 App 下载的内容，自动将相似连拍分组并使用按颜色标记高亮。 快捷整理 把不想要的照片和视频随手上滑加入待删除，统一删除；底部并排显示个人相簿，让您可以快速将照片加入其中。 回忆漫游 像刷短视频一样回看视频与相似照片，使用手势随时删除或快捷归类到相簿。 高清原片 查看储存在 iCloud 中未经压缩的视频与实况高清原片，让您的回忆细节更真实。 H.265视频压缩 找出大体积视频，并压缩为编码效率更高、更实用的大小，无缝对比压缩前后的画质差异。 实况照片完整支持 显示实况照片动态部分真实占用大小，支持转换为静态并释放空间、并将视频转换为实况。 旅行足迹分组 按行程足迹划分照片组，帮助你从大量零散相册内容中重新找回每次出行的难忘回忆。 有温度的照片定位 对于存在位置信息的照片，同步显示当天的气温与天气，让您的每一次回忆都有温度。 适合你，如果你 相册里有大量视频、截图、连拍和旅行照片 想像刷短视频一样轻松地回顾过往的照片和视频 想在浏览的过程中自然地丢弃不需要的照片，而不是繁琐地挨个删除 存在大量占据存储空间的视频与实况，想压缩却又担心影响画质 【AirPhotos 让相册整理伴随每一次自然浏览，而不是一场繁琐清理。】 隐私政策：https://www.termsfeed.com/live/817de70a-ac65-4b2c-b8c2-2376dd31aee0 用户协议：https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

cn.releaseNotes: 优化周爬楼信息显示
cn.trackName: 爬楼助手 - 支持watch手表爬楼梯打卡
cn.description: 爬楼助手是一款专为爬楼梯运动爱好者打造的记录与激励工具。无论你是想通过爬楼梯燃脂塑形、增强心肺，还是希望在日常通勤中坚持运动，爬楼助手都能陪你一起完成目标。 核心功能 精准记录，三种方式任你选 支持 Apple Health 自动同步爬楼数据，无需手动操作；也可手动记录每次运动，保留训练细节；还能实时记录，边爬边看进度变化。 可视化统计，看见你的坚持 周、月、年多维度趋势图，总楼层、日均、最高单日、运动天数、达标天数一目了然。升级 Pro 解锁打卡热力图和数据来源分布饼图，深度洞察你的运动规律。 成就勋章，激励持续前行 累计楼层、连续打卡、单日突破三大类勋章体系，青铜、白银、黄金、钻石四个等级。每一次突破都有专属解锁动画与粒子特效，让坚持变得有仪式感。 目标提醒，养成健康习惯 自定义每日、每周爬楼目标，设置运动提醒时间。达成目标时弹出庆祝卡片，支持分享给好友，让进步被更多人看见。 楼层换算，运动效果更直观 输入楼层数，自动换算为距离、步数、消耗热量与预计时长，帮你更好地了解每次运动的实际效果。 Apple Watch 联动，运动更自由 在 Apple Watch 上实时记录爬楼运动，查看今日进度与连续打卡。数据自动同步到 iPhone，告别手机束缚，专注运动本身。 桌面小组件，进度时刻可见 把今日爬楼进度放到主屏幕，目标完成情况一眼可见。中、大尺寸完整数据看板，让你随时掌握运动状态。 Apple Watch：手表独立记录运动与数据同步 高级小组件：主屏/锁屏多样化小组件 适合人群 希望日常爬楼梯健身的上班族 想燃脂塑形、增强心肺的运动爱好者 追求健康习惯养成与自我激励的人群 喜爱数据可视化与成就激励的用户 让每一次爬楼都被记录，让健康成为日常习惯。开始你的爬楼之旅吧！ 会员订阅和说明 提供Pro月度会员、季度、年度会员自动续费订阅，以及终身会员一次性购买。Pro 会员权益开通后可以使用 智能校对：覆盖今日 Health 数据，精准校对 Apple Watch：手表独立记录运动与数据同步 高级Widget小组件：主屏/锁屏多样化小组件 高级图表：解锁打卡热力图、数据来源分布饼图 完整勋章：解锁全部成就勋章与等级体系 主题外观：多种配色主题与自定义主色 数据导出：导出 CSV 备份与深度分析 自动续订说明： 月度、季度和年度会员为自动续订订阅，会在当前周期结束前24小时内自动续订。 账户将在当前周期结束前24小时内收取续订费用。 您可以在购买后前往 App Store 账户设置，随时管理或取消自动续订。 终身会员为一次性购买，无需续订，购买后永久有效。 隐私政策：https://luckyxiangfeng.github.io/ClimbAssistantPrivacy.html 用户协议：https://luckyxiangfeng.github.io/ClimbAssistant_user_agreement.html

cn.releaseNotes: Accessibility improvements: search results now respect Reduce Motion user preference.
cn.description: PlayTally is the ultimate music companion that takes your listening experience to the next level. REAL-TIME REPLAY Now you have the power to relive your favorite songs anytime, not just on a yearly basis. PlayTally generates lists in real-time, ensuring you're always up to date with your music trends. Choose any date range and discover your top tracks for that specific period. Plus, you can easily mark tracks like white noise and sleep sounds to keep them out of your Trends list. TRACK YOUR HISTORY Track your music history effortlessly by syncing PlayTally data across multiple devices through iCloud Music Library. you can even track additional Apple Music devices. Take a trip down memory lane and see what you were jamming to on any given day. Plus, create personalized playlists from your music history. EARN AWARDS As you dive deeper into your music journey, PlayTally rewards you with badges for your dedication and growing music collection. It's like earning activity awards for your ears! SEE YOUR STATS Explore your music collection like never before with PlayTally's advanced statistics and charts. Easily sort and browse through large libraries based on your listening habits. Gain valuable insights into your music preferences over time and share your most impressive stats with friends and followers. COMPLETELY AD-FREE. No distractions, no interruptions. PlayTally is completely ad-free and seamlessly integrates with your Apple Music. No extra accounts, signups, or subscriptions required. PRIVACY FIRST Your privacy is our priority – your data stays on your device and personal iCloud storage, and you have the option to delete it whenever you want. If you wish, you can also export and backup your data in CSV format. You're in control. TIPS FOR BEST PERFORMANCE For optimal performance, make sure PlayTally regularly scans your music library. Create a convenient automated shortcut to open PlayTally daily or weekly, ensuring your data is always up to date and accurate. NOTE: Because PlayTally tracks its own data, it cannot reconstruct playback history from before it was installed.
